containers.name: files
containers.description: Delivery drop for dashboard-ready files. Modeled as shared across pipelines, matching this project's convention for every other generically-named real path segment (ToLAKE, mymo, dv_raw, delta/datasource, ...) -- not independently confirmed for this path, since the source doc only names this one pipeline's use of it.

containers.name: loan_repayment_tracking
containers.description: Daily (T-3) gzipped delivery of the loan repayment tracking summary: daily_loan_aging_class_summary_yyyymmdd.tsv.gz. Same content as the HDFS gold_safe loan_repayment_tracking output -- assumed same schema, not independently confirmed.

columns.name: product
columns.description: Loan product code, taken from account_subtype_name on the loan account information input.

columns.name: loan_class
columns.description: 1-5, or Closed when loan_status is deactivate.

columns.name: number_of_accounts_current
columns.description: Count of accounts in this product/loan_class for the current calendar month.

columns.name: number_of_accounts_previous_month
columns.description: Count of accounts in this product/loan_class for the previous calendar month.

columns.name: average_acs_score_current
columns.description: Average current_credit_score for this product/loan_class in the current calendar month.

columns.name: average_ace_score_when_apply
columns.description: Average score at time of application for this product/loan_class. See draft notes on the HDFS gold_safe container: the source doc names/computes this field inconsistently between its execution-logic text and its own output-schema table.
